title: Serialize concurrent native-lane launcher operations
body: Two queued commands launched tools/vixen-native.sh --lane nodialog1 concurrently; both ran do_sync against /mnt/c/vixen-native/nodialog1 and the headless probe failed before execution with fatal: Unable to create .git/index.lock: File exists. Waiting for the binding job and rerunning the probe recovered the witness. The launcher should own a per-lane native checkout/build mutex or queue native operations by lane so concurrent test/capture jobs cannot race git sync and native build locks. Tier reason: several launcher phases and Windows/WSL ownership need moderate investigation; effort S.

title: Reconfirm native CTest batch argument transport for queue-granted suites
body: The queued binding witness used tools/run-native-cpu-suite.bat -R ViewHudGolden.GeneratedBindFunctionCompilesAndBinds and reached cmd.exe, but the batch's nested set "VIXEN_PHASE_ARGS=..." quoting failed before CTest with a cmd syntax error (the same boundary reported by cx-hudkit1 for native GPU regex arguments). Recovery is to construct VIXEN_PHASE_ARGS without the outer set quotes and escape the exclusion alternation, then rerun. Consolidate one safe structured CTest argument transport for both native CPU/GPU wrappers. Tier reason: one batch argument boundary with an existing sibling repro; effort S.
